messages:
sana: Hi all — I'm Sana, starting on infra today. No Okta activation arrived, Google Workspace sign-in says 'pending provisioning', and the 1Password onboarding link 403s. Also need to register a YubiKey for MFA and add my SSH key. Who should I reach out to?

it-ops-bot: Automation: No Okta activation record found for sana@redwood.dev. If email is correct, DM @leigh or open a ticket in #it-ops.

leigh: Welcome @sana! Confirming email sana@redwood.dev and device (mac/linux). I'll resend Okta and start Google sync. For YubiKey, we support WebAuthn via Okta; after activation you can register it in Security > Add authenticator.

sana: Correct email. MacBook Pro Ventura. Thanks — I got the Okta invite just now and finished activation, but when I try to register the YubiKey Okta complains 'no compatible authenticator found' in Chrome. Works in Safari.

morgan: Hey @sana — on Mac with Chrome make sure system prefs allow USB accessory access and disable any extension that might block WebAuthn. Also try removing the 1Password browser extension while you register the key; we've seen it intercept the USB prompt.

sana: Removing 1Password extension fixed the YubiKey registration. Browser question — 1Password browser UI still 403 but CLI works after op signin.

security-bot: Reminder: do not paste private keys or tokens in channel. If browser 403 persists, we usually add vault membership server-side. @leigh can confirm.

leigh: I added you to the infra vault and re-sent the 1Password browser invite link. If you still see 403 clear site cookies for accounts.1password.com and try again.

sana: Browser invite now works. One last piece — SSH key workflow? Do I upload public key to GitHub Enterprise or ask infra team to add to deploy manager?

devex: For personal dev access add your SSH public key to your GitHub Enterprise profile and request org access in #eng-setup. For machine/deploy keys open a ticket to eng-platform.

sana: Added key to GitHub and requested org access. All set for day one, thanks everyone :partyparrot:

leigh: Great to have you @sana — ping me if anything else pops up!
